title: Bulk mode on the Inactive tab behaves exactly as on the Active tab
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919). The Admin role has 'Part Library & Inventory → View / Create & Edit / Delete'.
  • Inventory part {Part-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-01, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Alpha") is inactive at {Location-A}, in category {Category-A} (for example the first category offered).
  • Inventory part {Part-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-02, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Bravo") is inactive, in {Category-A}.
  • Inventory part {Part-C} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-03, description "ZZAUTOTEST PL mirror Charlie") is inactive, in category {Category-B} (for example the second category offered).
  • All three part numbers start with {Prefix-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR); a longer search text {Prefix-B} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-PL-MIRROR-0) still matches all three.
  • You can open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address, signed in as the same user.
custom_steps:
1. In the top bar click Parts, then click Inventory in the left menu.
  2. Click the Inactive tab.
  3. Type {Prefix-A} in the Search box.
  4. Click the {Part-A} row.
  5. Click Cancel.
  6. Click the ⋮ actions menu button in the toolbar, to the left of New Inventory Part.
  7. Click Activate parts.
  8. Click the {Part-A} row.
  9. Click the {Part-A} row again.
  10. Click the checkbox in the header row.
  11. Click the checkbox in the header row again.
  12. Click the {Part-A} row.
  13. Click the {Part-B} row.
  14. Click the Description column header.
  15. Change the Search text to {Prefix-B}.
  16. Click the {Part-A} row.
  17. Open the Category filter and pick {Category-A}.
  18. Open the Category filter and pick All categories.
  19. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  20. Press Escape to close the menu.
  21. Hover over the X at the right end of the bar.
  22. Click the X.
  23. Click the ⋮ actions menu button.
  24. Click Activate parts.
  25. Click the {Part-A} row.
  26. Click the {Part-B} row.
  27. Open a second browser tab on the same ShopView address and go to Parts → Inventory (tab 2).
  28. In tab 2, click the Inactive tab.
  29. In tab 2, type {Part-B} in the Search box.
  30. In tab 2, click the {Part-B} row.
  31. In tab 2, pick Part Status → Active.
  32. In tab 2, click Save.
  33. In tab 2, click Activate in the "Activate part?" confirmation.
  34. Go back to tab 1.
  35. Do not reload tab 1.
  36. In tab 1, click the Activate button on the bar.
  37. In tab 1, click Activate in the "Activate parts?" confirmation.
  38. Click Close on the toast.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 4: With bulk mode off, the row click opens Edit Inventory Part for {Part-A}, and there is no checkbox column.
  • Step 7: The checkbox column and the dark bar appear, reading "0 selected", with a blue "Activate" button.
  • Step 8: The {Part-A} row is ticked ("1 selected") and no dialog opens.
  • Step 9: The {Part-A} row is unticked ("0 selected").
  • Step 10: All 3 loaded rows are ticked ("3 selected").
  • Step 11: All ticks are cleared ("0 selected").
  • Step 13: The bar reads "2 selected".
  • Step 14: The rows are re-ordered by Description and {Part-A} and {Part-B} stay ticked ("2 selected").
  • Step 15: The ticks are cleared ("0 selected") although all three parts are still listed.
  • Step 17: The ticks are cleared ("0 selected") and only {Part-A} and {Part-B} are listed.
  • Step 18: All three parts are listed again, none ticked.
  • Step 19: The menu offers only "Export".
  • Step 21: Hovering the X shows "Clear selection".
  • Step 22: Bulk mode ends, and the checkbox column and the bar disappear.
  • Step 23: The menu lists "Cycle count", "Activate parts" and "Export" again.
  • Step 37: A red error toast reads "1 part updated, 1 could not be changed." and lists {Part-B} with the reason "Part is already in that state." Bulk mode stays on and only {Part-B} stays ticked ("1 selected"), and {Part-A} leaves the Inactive list.
  • Step 38: The toast stayed on screen until you closed it, and now closes.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-10647; story SV-10816 (Story 3, Activate Parts in Bulk); story SV-10815 (Story 2, Deactivate Parts in Bulk); PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, v29 (14 Oct 2026 copy), S3-R3, S2-R3, S2-R5, S2-R6, S2-R9, S2-R10a, S2-R10b, S2-R15, §8 User Feedback Summary, read 14 Oct 2026; design canvas board 4.6 (Inactive tab, Activate parts), board 4.8 (Branch: the menu while the mode is on), 13 Oct copy. Source-verified 14 October 2026; not yet build-verified (no Part Lifecycle QA build exists).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S3-R3: “S2-R3 to S2-R10b, S2-R14 to S2-R17 and S2-N3 apply on the Inactive tab exactly as on the Active tab, with "deactivate" read as "activate". The disabled button's hover text is "Tick the parts to activate".”
  • S2-R3: “Outside the mode the Inventory list has no checkbox column, and a row click opens the part.”
  • S2-R5: “While the mode is on, a click anywhere on a row ticks or unticks that row instead of opening the part.”
  • S2-R6: “The checkbox in the header ticks or clears every row loaded in the list. The list loads 30 parts at a time as the user scrolls, so it ticks only the rows loaded so far. The count in the bar shows exactly how many parts will change.”
  • S2-R10a: “Changing the search term or a filter clears the ticks, so the user only ever changes parts they can see. Sorting keeps them.”
  • S2-R10b: “While the mode is on, the actions menu offers only Export. Cycle count and the bulk entry come back when the mode ends.”
  • S2-R9: “An X button sits at the right end of the bar. Hovering it shows "Clear selection", which is also its screen reader label.”
  • S2-R15: “When some parts fail, the mode stays on and the selection keeps only the parts that failed.”
  • PRD §8 User Feedback Summary (Bulk change, some parts failed): “"{n} parts updated, {m} could not be changed." ("1 part updated, {m} could not be changed." for one) | Error toast, stays until closed, lists each failed part and its reason”
